objective.text: Correlate queued notification channels using the shared notification ID for each recipient without assuming one ID covers all recipients.

difficulty.rationale: Correlate the channel jobs of one recipient without merging separate recipients into one notification identity.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: Laravel 13.40; the notification has no explicitly assigned id. Two recipients each use mail and database.

stem: Four queued channel jobs are created. How are their notification IDs assigned by the normal sender?

options.text: All four jobs share one ID because the same notification instance was passed to send.
options.rationale: Without an explicit id, the sender creates the identifier inside the recipient loop.
options.misconception: Without an explicit id, the sender creates the identifier inside the recipient loop.

options.text: The two channels for one recipient share an ID; the other recipient gets a different ID.
options.rationale: The sender creates an ID per recipient and carries it into the cloned notification for each of that recipient’s channels.

options.text: Every channel job has a different ID, including channels for the same recipient.
options.rationale: The default ID is shared across a recipient’s channel clones.
options.misconception: The default ID is shared across a recipient’s channel clones.

options.text: Only the database channel has an ID; mail jobs have none.
options.rationale: The queued notification object receives the recipient ID before individual channel jobs are dispatched.
options.misconception: The queued notification object receives the recipient ID before individual channel jobs are dispatched.

explanation.summary: The sender creates an ID per recipient and carries it into the cloned notification for each of that recipient’s channels.
